__note: Keyed map for GET /api/v4/entity/AuditInspection/fetch/{RowUID}. The mock looks up the trailing RowUID path param and returns the matching value (which has the shape { Entity: {...} }). Used by BOTH workflows: Create WO source module 64 ('EHS: Fetch Inspection Detail' -> reads $json.Entity), and Update source module 4 ('EHS: Fetch Inspection' -> reads $json.Entity, then mutates UDFLimbleWOCompletionNotes and POSTs it back). Question fields consumed: Answer ('0'==unacceptable), Verification (deficiency text), FileAttachments[0].{AttachmentUID,FileName}. Entity fields consumed: RowUID, FormNumber, BusinessEntity, QuestionsSelector, UpdatedDtm, RecurringTaskCompleteDtm, Questions.
__updateddtm_format_note: KEEP THIS FILE SINGLE-FORMAT. Every UpdatedDtm here is ISO with T/Z ('2026-07-08T15:00:00Z'); live EHS emits '2026-07-24 05:12:01' instead. n07 compares UpdatedDtm as STRINGS (deliberate — see build-spec section 13), which is chronologically correct for either format on its own since both are fixed-width and zero-padded, but WRONG for a set that MIXES them: 'T' (0x54) sorts above ' ' (0x20), so any ISO value beats any space-separated value on the same date regardless of actual time. Adding a live-shaped row to this fixture set would silently corrupt the A1/A2 and J comparisons.

EHS-INSP-I.__note: Case I (OQ-037 draft guard, added 2026-07-26). BE-60's ONLY in-window inspection, and it is an unsubmitted draft: RecurringTaskCompleteDtm is "". The pre-dedupe guard in 'Filter To Latest Completed' (n07) must drop it, so BE-60 yields zero tasks. Its last question is deliberately deficient (Answer == '0') so a regressed guard would visibly try to create a WO instead of failing silently. Primary assertion is at n07's OUTPUT (EHS-INSP-I absent) — a drop further downstream would prove nothing about the guard. No hierarchy fixture and no Limble sandbox seeding: nothing downstream of n07 runs for BE-60.

EHS-INSP-J.__note: Case J (OQ-037 guard-runs-before-comparison, added 2026-07-26). Draft at BE-30 (same site as E) whose UpdatedDtm 18:00 is LATER than E's 13:30, and it is listed BEFORE E in ehs-auditinspection-list.json. Correct behavior: the guard drops J pre-dedupe, so E survives untouched (instruction text '...E: Blocked emergency exit', meta1 = EHS-INSP-E). A 'drop drafts after picking the max' implementation would keep J and cut a WO from a draft — this case fails it while case I still passes, which is why J is the sharper of the two. Assert EHS-INSP-J absent from n07's output and no task name containing FIC-3001. Reuses E's already-seeded Limble location/region/team — no new sandbox seeding.
